protocol.order: same process, alternate before/after and after/before each pair
protocol.timed: Immediate cases: NativeRenderer::render + submission.wait. Retained cases: transaction commit + render_retained + submission.wait. Compilation and readback excluded.
protocol.pixels: 19 paired workloads preserve exact baseline/cleanup pixels. Image translations also compare a fresh renderer. Repeated image/SDF relayout validates fixed output against a fresh renderer and reproduces incorrect baseline output; it has no before timing because incorrect pixels are not a fair performance reference.

scene.path_case: same geometry as 128 rectangles, submitted as vector paths to a cropped isolated blur

retained.sparse_translation: one node per frame, translated 1/2 px alternately per 256-frame cycle
retained.dense_translation: all nodes translated 0/1 px every frame
retained.group_opacity: eight opacity groups, each with 32 leaves; one group changes 0.5/0.8 per frame

resource_images.sparse_translation: one leaf per frame, 1/2px alternating per 256-frame cycle
resource_images.relayout: one sparse image translation plus another leaf alternating 16 vector paths/16 SDF rectangles, same brush storage length, full damage; corrected-only timing
